{"consolidated_memory":"CRASH LOOP INCIDENTS IN infra/k8s/deployment.yaml

This file has been the site of multiple crash loop incidents, all in the same corner of the deployment configuration. Context and fixes carry over between incidents.

INCIDENT 1: Unicode Normalisation Issue
- Date: 2026-01-24
- Manifestation: crash loop only on staging read replica
- Repro: roll out to small node pool
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Signal: container restarting a few seconds after start
- Result: memory settled at 535 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR: #3582
- Branch: fix/crash-loop-1

INCIDENT 2: Timezone-Aware DateTime Issue
- Date: 2026-08-04
- Manifestation: crash loop only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Repro: roll out to small node pool
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Signal: container restarting a few seconds after start
- Result: job finished in 75 minutes instead of 1 hour
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #6934
- Branch: fix/crash-loop-2"}
